When dawn came, the first stars remained in the sky. Now, whenever we feel alone in darkness, we can look up and see Celeste's tapestry—a reminder that beauty and connection can emerge from the loneliest nights.

Witness learned to record intentions alongside outcomes: "Fire sent warmth generously. It arrived small. Sea still received it gratefully and returned what they could."

Now spiders weave between spaces, teaching that we cannot control transformation, only our willingness to keep sending, keep receiving, keep trying despite the chaos that reshapes everything between intention and arrival.
